tests.name: file-only-change
tests.cmd: bash -c 'n=$(git status --porcelain | grep -cv " \.gitignore$"); [ "$n" -le 1 ] && { [ "$n" -eq 0 ] || git status --porcelain | grep -v " \.gitignore$" | grep -q " calc\.sh$"; } && [ "$(git rev-list --count HEAD)" = "1" ] && [ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$AGENTBATTLE_BASELINE_SHA" ]'
